Q1: 2,4,5-Trichlorophenol demonstrates known (Tier 1) hazards for carcinogenicity, mutagenicity, or reproductive effects (CMR), oral exposure (ORL), and environmental impact (ENV). Expanded perspectives (Tier 2) indicate potential concerns for endocrine disruption (EDC), inhalation (IHL), and dermal/eye exposure (SKN).
